items.reason_en: Path equivalence resolution flaw in WebDAV enables network RCE, exploiting widely used network file sharing protocols for unauthorized code execution.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的路径等价解析缺陷可导致网络远程代码执行，利用广泛使用的网络文件共享协议进行未授权代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 remote code execution in Windows RRAS directly compromises core routing and remote access infrastructure, enabling full network control and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的远程代码执行漏洞直接破坏核心路由与远程访问基础设施，实现完全的网络控制与横向移动。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 integer underflow in Network Policy Server allows network-based code execution, breaking critical network access policy enforcement and gateway security.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的整数下溢漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，破坏关键的网络访问策略执行与网关安全。

items.reason_en: Critical flaw in the Linksys E1700 router's static route handler allows unauthorized manipulation of network routing tables, potentially enabling traffic interception, redirection, or complete denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Linksys E1700 路由器静态路由处理程序中的严重缺陷允许未授权操纵网络路由表，可能导致流量拦截、重定向或完全拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in the DNS Server component allows unauthorized network-based code execution, threatening critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 组件中的类型混淆漏洞允许未授权的基于网络的代码执行，威胁关键名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: A race condition in the DHCP Server enables remote code execution over the network, compromising dynamic address management systems.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的竞态条件漏洞可通过网络实现远程代码执行，破坏动态地址管理系统。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Windows iSCSI permits remote code execution, exposing storage networking protocols to severe exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，使存储网络协议面临严重利用风险。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion flaws in the SMB Server allow network-based denial of service, disrupting file sharing and enterprise connectivity.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server 中的资源耗尽缺陷允许基于网络的拒绝服务攻击，破坏文件共享与企业网络连接。

items.reason_en: An integer underflow in Kerberos facilitates local privilege escalation, weakening core authentication mechanisms within Active Directory environments.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos 中的整数下溢漏洞有助于本地权限提升，削弱 Active Directory 环境中的核心认证机制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 use-after-free in Windows TCP/IP stack enables unauthorized remote code execution, directly impacting network connectivity and infrastructure stability.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中 CVSS 评分为 8.1 的释放后使用漏洞可实现未授权的远程代码执行，直接影响网络连接性与基础设施稳定性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 out-of-bounds write in Windows DHCP Server allows unauthorized remote code execution, threatening critical network address allocation services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中 CVSS 评分为 7.5 的越界写入漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行，威胁关键的网络地址分配服务。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 untrusted pointer dereference in Windows DFS enables unauthorized remote privilege escalation, compromising distributed file replication across networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows DFS 中 CVSS 评分为 7.5 的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可实现未授权的远程权限提升，破坏跨网络的文件复制功能。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in the J-Web interface allows unauthenticated network attackers to obtain root-level device configuration access, enabling complete network takeover.
items.reason_zh: J-Web 接口中的身份验证不当漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者获取设备配置的 root 级访问权限，从而实现完整的网络接管。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the routing protocol daemon via crafted BGP/EVPN route advertisements can lead to root code execution or severe service disruption.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造的 BGP/EVPN 路由通告，路由协议守护进程中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可导致 root 级代码执行或严重的服务中断。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the service-deployment daemon permits remote unauthenticated attackers to execute code as root or cause denial of service.
items.reason_zh: 服务部署守护进程中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程未授权攻击者以 root 权限执行代码或引发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: XML injection in the Unified Threat Management daemon allows unauthenticated attackers to commit arbitrary device configurations with root privileges via malicious URL-feed responses.
items.reason_zh: 统一威胁管理守护进程中的 XML 注入漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过恶意的 URL 源响应，以 root 权限提交任意设备配置。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow triggered by flow-spec updates allows configured BGP peers to achieve remote code execution or crash the routing daemon.
items.reason_zh: 由 flow-spec 更新触发的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许已配置的 BGP 对等体实现远程代码执行或导致路由守护进程崩溃。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Juniper SRX SVR processing allows unauthenticated remote attackers to cause denial of service or achieve code execution via malformed IPv4 packets.
items.reason_zh: Juniper SRX SVR 处理中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，未认证的远程攻击者可通过畸形 IPv4 数据包导致拒绝服务或实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Juniper SRX ipfd daemon permits unauthenticated network attackers to execute code with root privileges through manipulated security intelligence feed connections.
items.reason_zh: Juniper SRX ipfd 守护进程存在 SQL 注入漏洞，未认证的网络攻击者可通过篡改安全情报馈送连接以 root 权限执行代码。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in NGINX triggered by asynchronous file I/O and SSI processing can crash worker processes or enable remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: NGINX 中由异步文件 I/O 和 SSI 处理触发的释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞可导致工作进程崩溃或启用远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption via regex map directives in NGINX compromises worker stability and may facilitate exploitation under specific routing configurations.
items.reason_zh: NGINX 中通过 regex map 指令导致的内存破坏会损害工作进程稳定性，并在特定路由配置下可能促进漏洞利用。

items.reason_en: Flawed variable handling in NGINX alias and rewrite directives enables path traversal and unauthorized access to internal resources.
items.reason_zh: NGINX alias 和 rewrite 指令中变量处理缺陷可导致路径遍历及未经授权访问内部资源。

items.reason_en: Forgery of client SSL sessions becomes possible when session ticket keys are not rotated, undermining transport layer security for proxied traffic.
items.reason_zh: 若未轮换会话票证密钥，则可能伪造客户端 SSL 会话，从而削弱代理流量的传输层安全性。

items.reason_en: Mishandled OAuth responses in F5 NGINX Ingress Controller bypass external authentication, granting unauthenticated access to protected ingress paths.
items.reason_zh: F5 NGINX Ingress Controller 中 OAuth 响应处理不当可绕过外部认证，授予对受保护入口路径的未认证访问权限。

items.reason_en: Fortinet FortiMail versions suffer from SQL injection allowing authenticated attackers to execute unauthorized commands. This compromises email security gateways and can lead to data exfiltration or service disruption.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiMail 多个版本存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许已认证的攻击者执行未授权命令。该漏洞危及邮件安全网关，可能导致数据泄露或服务中断。

items.reason_en: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer and Cloud variants contain SQL injection flaws exploitable by authenticated users. These log aggregation and analytics appliances handle sensitive network telemetry, making this a critical threat to security monitoring infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 及其 Cloud 版本包含 SQL 注入漏洞，可被已认证用户利用。这些日志聚合与分析设备处理敏感的网络遥测数据，因此对该安全监控基础设施构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0 exhibits a path traversal vulnerability allowing unauthorized code execution via crafted packets. As a centralized SIEM appliance, this flaw undermines log integrity and incident response capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0 存在路径遍历漏洞，允许通过构造的数据包执行未授权代码。作为集中式 SIEM 设备，此缺陷破坏了日志完整性与事件响应能力。

items.reason_en: Grafana's Geomap panel contains a stored XSS vulnerability exploitable by editors to hijack sessions and escalate to Org Admin. This impacts cloud monitoring dashboards commonly deployed in network operations centers.
items.reason_zh: Grafana 的 Geomap 面板存在存储型 XSS 漏洞，编辑者可利用该漏洞劫持会话并提升权限至 Org Admin。这会影响通常在网络运营中心部署的云监控仪表板。

items.reason_en: Nginx UI backup restoration feature trusts attacker-controlled key material, allowing authenticated administrators to trigger remote code execution. This undermines secure configuration management for web servers.
items.reason_zh: Nginx UI 备份恢复功能信任攻击者控制的密钥材料，允许已认证的管理员触发远程代码执行。这破坏了 Web 服务器的安全配置管理。

items.reason_en: Nginx UI exposes node tokens to ordinary users, which can be reused to escalate privileges and map requests to initUser. Token leakage in management interfaces poses persistent access risks.
items.reason_zh: Nginx UI 向普通用户暴露节点令牌，这些令牌可被重用以提升权限并将请求映射至 initUser。管理接口中的令牌泄露会带来持久化访问风险。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted internal API access in Siemens systems exposes sensitive operational data and could facilitate deeper system compromise by authenticated remote attackers.
items.reason_zh: Siemens 系统中不受限制的内部 API 访问会暴露敏感的运行数据，并可能被已认证的远程攻击者利用以进一步深入渗透系统。

items.reason_en: Improper sanitization of imported trace files enables social engineering attacks against authorized personnel to steal credentials or trigger malicious diagnostic actions.
items.reason_zh: 导入的跟踪文件清理不当会导致针对授权人员的社会工程学攻击，从而窃取凭据或触发恶意诊断操作。

items.reason_en: Multiple flaws in Siemens APOGEE building automation controllers affect widely deployed HVAC and control systems, risking operational disruption and unauthorized configuration changes.
items.reason_zh: Siemens APOGEE 楼宇自动化控制器存在多项缺陷，影响广泛部署的 HVAC 及控制系统，可能导致运行中断和未经授权的配置更改。

items.reason_en: Session privilege bypass in Ignition Perspective module allows Vision users to gain Designer-level access, risking unauthorized configuration changes in operational technology environments.
items.reason_zh: Ignition Perspective 模块中的会话权限绕过漏洞允许 Vision 用户获取 Designer 级别访问权限，在运营技术环境中可能导致未经授权的配置更改。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization of the output-port field in the GenericHub component can lead to out-of-bounds memory access or crashes in spaceflight and embedded control systems.
items.reason_zh: GenericHub 组件中 output-port 字段的不安全反序列化可能导致航天飞行及嵌入式控制系统中出现越界内存访问或崩溃。

items.reason_en: Insufficient offset and size validation in the FileUplink component allows integer wraparound vulnerabilities, potentially corrupting data packets in critical embedded applications.
items.reason_zh: FileUplink 组件中偏移量和大小验证不足会导致整数回绕漏洞，可能损坏关键嵌入式应用程序中的数据报文。

items.reason_en: A remote code execution flaw in HPE NonStop SNMP Trap Multiplexer could disrupt legacy mainframe and operational technology networks reliant on SNMP monitoring.
items.reason_zh: HPE NonStop SNMP Trap Multiplexer 中的远程代码执行漏洞可能破坏依赖 SNMP 监控的传统大型机及运营技术网络。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in OpENer's EtherNet/IP GetAttributeList implementation enables remote denial of service against industrial controllers. Disruption of PLC communication protocols impacts manufacturing uptime.
items.reason_zh: OpENer 的 EtherNet/IP GetAttributeList 实现中存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可对工业控制器实施远程拒绝服务。PLC 通信协议的中断将影响制造业务的正常运行时间。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL Injection in StellarWP Event Tickets allows attackers to extract or manipulate backend database contents, compromising event management platforms.
items.reason_zh: StellarWP Event Tickets 中的盲注 SQL 注入漏洞允许攻击者提取或操纵后端数据库内容，危及活动管理平台。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in the Azure Portal enables attacker-controlled spoofing and potential session hijacking against cloud administrators.
items.reason_zh: Azure Portal 中的跨站脚本漏洞使攻击者能够进行受控欺骗，并可能对云管理员实施潜在的会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in Power Automate allows local privilege escalation by manipulating file access paths within automated workflow engines.
items.reason_zh: Power Automate 中的相对路径遍历漏洞允许通过操纵自动化工作流引擎内的文件访问路径实现本地提权。

items.reason_en: SQL injection logic flaw in Microsoft Discovery Studio risks sensitive data disclosure through compromised query execution in analytical tools.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Discovery Studio 中的 SQL 注入逻辑缺陷可能导致分析工具中查询执行被篡改，进而引发敏感数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables attackers to perform spoofing and inject malicious scripts, compromising user trust and session integrity in enterprise web portals.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞使攻击者能够执行欺骗行为并注入恶意脚本，损害企业 Web 门户的用户信任与会话完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution, compromising web-based document management and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的访问控制不当漏洞可实现远程代码执行，危及基于 Web 的文档管理与协作平台。

items.reason_en: Incomplete comparison logic in Visual Studio Code bypasses security features, allowing unauthorized access to development environments and project files.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的比较逻辑不完整漏洞可绕过安全特性，允许未经授权访问开发环境与项目文件。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code enables internal network reconnaissance and potential data exfiltration from behind firewalls.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可支持内网侦察，并可能导致从防火墙后方窃取数据。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge can be leveraged to achieve local privilege escalation via maliciously crafted web content.
items.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Microsoft Edge 中存在竞态条件漏洞，可利用恶意构造的网页内容实现本地提权。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Skype for Business enables internal network reconnaissance and sensitive data disclosure through forged requests.
items.reason_zh: Skype for Business 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可通过伪造请求实现内网探测和敏感数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Media Foundation allows remote code execution through specially crafted multimedia payloads delivered over web channels.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的堆溢出漏洞允许通过 Web 通道投递的特制多媒体载荷实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Microsoft Bing enables network pivoting and unauthorized access to internal services from a major public-facing web platform.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Bing 中的 SSRF 漏洞使攻击者能够从主要对外 Web 平台进行网络跳板攻击并未经授权访问内部服务。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible denial-of-service in the .NET Framework impacts widespread web applications and backend services relying on this runtime.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中可网络访问的拒绝服务漏洞影响依赖该运行时的广泛 Web 应用及后端服务。

items.reason_en: High-severity spoofing flaw in Power Apps allows attackers to manipulate user interactions, steal credentials, or redirect traffic to malicious sites.
items.reason_zh: Power Apps 中的高危欺骗缺陷允许攻击者操纵用户交互、窃取凭据或将流量重定向至恶意站点。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated attackers bypass login mechanisms by reusing OAuth state tokens as Magic Link tokens, leading to direct account takeover.
items.reason_zh: 未授权攻击者通过重用 OAuth 状态令牌作为 Magic Link 令牌绕过登录机制，直接导致账户接管。

items.reason_en: Direct string substitution in Microsoft SQL node queries without parameterization exposes backend databases to SQL injection attacks via untrusted webhook inputs.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL 节点查询中未参数化的直接字符串替换，使后端数据库通过不受信任的 Webhook 输入暴露于 SQL 注入攻击之下。

items.reason_en: Shell metacharacters embedded in file paths passed to the thumbnail generation routine enable arbitrary command execution on web-facing applications.
items.reason_zh: 传递给缩略图生成例程的文件路径中嵌入的 Shell 元字符，可在面向 Web 的应用程序中实现任意命令执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP RCE via improper use of extract() allows direct code execution on charitable institution management servers, bypassing all input validation controls.
items.reason_zh: 因不当使用 extract() 函数导致的未授权 PHP 远程代码执行漏洞，可绕过所有输入验证控制，直接在慈善机构管理服务器上执行代码。

items.reason_en: Default installation exposes unauthenticated API endpoints that trust client-supplied headers, enabling unauthorized adversary simulation control and environment manipulation.
items.reason_zh: 默认安装会暴露信任客户端提供标头的未授权 API 端点，使攻击者能够未经授权进行对抗模拟控制和环境篡改。

items.reason_en: PHP object injection in ILIAS allows authenticated users to deserialize arbitrary objects via crafted archives, potentially leading to full application and backend compromise.
items.reason_zh: ILIAS 中的 PHP 对象注入漏洞允许已认证用户通过特制归档文件反序列化任意对象，可能导致应用程序及后端完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Broken access control in InvoiceShelf fails to validate resource types, allowing unauthorized access to sensitive financial documents via insecure direct object references.
items.reason_zh: InvoiceShelf 中的越权访问控制缺陷未能验证资源类型，允许通过不安全的直接对象引用未经授权访问敏感财务文档。

items.reason_en: GitLab's vulnerability allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary JavaScript in other users' browser sessions, facilitating account takeover and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: GitLab 的漏洞允许已认证用户在其他用户的浏览器会话中执行任意 JavaScript，从而促成账户接管与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Adobe Commerce's stored XSS vulnerability enables attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields, compromising victim browsers and potentially stealing session cookies.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce 中的存储型 XSS 漏洞使攻击者能够将恶意脚本注入表单字段，损害受害者浏览器并可能窃取会话 Cookie。

items.reason_en: A WordPress Booking Package plugin authorization bypass allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve personally identifiable information due to missing access controls.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Booking Package 插件的授权绕过漏洞因缺乏访问控制，允许未授权攻击者检索个人身份信息。

items.reason_en: The WordPress BP Profile Search plugin suffers from local file inclusion via a manipulated cookie during AJAX requests, exposing sensitive server files to attackers.
items.reason_zh: WordPress BP Profile Search 插件在 AJAX 请求期间通过篡改 Cookie 存在本地文件包含漏洞，使敏感服务器文件暴露给攻击者。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in e107 CMS authentication backends allows unauthorized database access, exploiting common flaws in legacy web deployments and installer routines.
items.reason_zh: e107 CMS 认证后端存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可利用传统 Web 部署和安装程序中的常见缺陷实现未经授权的数据库访问。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in WPManageNinja Best Payments Plugin compromises user sessions and site integrity, highlighting ongoing risks in popular WordPress payment ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: WPManageNinja Best Payments 插件中的存储型 XSS 漏洞会破坏用户会话和站点完整性，凸显了流行 WordPress 支付生态系统中持续存在的风险。

items.reason_en: Code injection in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, directly impacting web application security.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的代码注入漏洞允许未授权攻击者远程执行任意代码，直接影响 Web 应用安全。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to tamper with requests and responses, facilitating cache poisoning and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞允许攻击者篡改请求与响应，从而促成缓存投毒与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables credential spoofing and phishing campaigns targeting enterprise email users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现凭据伪造及针对企业邮件用户的钓鱼攻击活动。

items.reason_en: Input neutralization failure in ASP.NET Core leads to cross-site scripting vulnerabilities, allowing malicious script injection in web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的输入净化失败会导致跨站脚本漏洞，允许在 Web 应用中注入恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the Printcart WooCommerce plugin directly leads to remote code execution, immediately endangering e-commerce storefronts and customer data.
items.reason_zh: Printcart WooCommerce 插件中的未授权任意文件上传漏洞直接导致远程代码执行，立即危及电商前台与客户数据。

items.reason_en: Unescaped single quotes in HestiaCP allow authenticated command injection, leading to complete server compromise and control panel takeover.
items.reason_zh: HestiaCP 中未转义的单引号允许已认证用户进行命令注入，导致服务器完全沦陷与控制面板被接管。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables network spoofing and session hijacking against enterprise users relying on the platform for document collaboration.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可对依赖该平台进行文档协作的企业用户实施网络欺骗与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Time-based SQL injection in the WordPress Gmedia plugin exposes database contents to unauthenticated attackers due to insufficient input sanitization.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Gmedia 插件中的基于时间的 SQL 注入因输入净化不足，使数据库内容暴露给未授权攻击者。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows security feature bypass, enabling cache poisoning, session hijacking, and backend server attacks.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞可绕过安全特性，实现缓存投毒、会话劫持及后端服务器攻击。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET permits network RCE, representing a classic and highly exploitable web framework vulnerability across numerous applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致网络远程代码执行，代表了一种在大量应用中普遍存在且极易利用的经典 Web 框架漏洞。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Microsoft SharePoint allows network RCE, compromising enterprise document management, collaboration platforms, and sensitive organizational data.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，危及企业文档管理、协作平台及敏感组织数据。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in the WordPress Verified Reviews plugin enables unauthenticated attacker injection via insufficient input sanitization, affecting millions of websites.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Verified Reviews 插件中的存储型 XSS 漏洞因输入净化不足，使未授权攻击者得以注入恶意内容，影响数百万个网站。

items.reason_en: HTTP request buffering flaw in the MCP Python SDK exposes emerging AI integration endpoints to potential request smuggling or denial of service attacks.
items.reason_zh: MCP Python SDK 中的 HTTP 请求缓冲缺陷使新兴的 AI 集成端点面临请求走私或拒绝服务攻击的风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.0 heap-based buffer overflow in WebDAV exploits widely deployed network file-sharing protocols, potentially allowing privilege escalation through crafted HTTP requests.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中 CVSS 7.0 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞利用了广泛部署的网络文件共享协议，可能通过构造的 HTTP 请求实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Incomplete file type validation in the FV Flowplayer WordPress plugin enables limited arbitrary file uploads, potentially leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: FV Flowplayer WordPress 插件中的文件类型验证不完整可导致有限的任意文件上传，进而可能引发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated file upload capabilities in LogicalDOC Community Edition allow attackers to persist malicious files on disk without valid sessions.
items.reason_zh: LogicalDOC Community Edition 的未授权文件上传功能允许攻击者在无有效会话的情况下将恶意文件持久化存储到磁盘。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.6 path traversal vulnerability in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized remote code execution, severely impacting developer environments and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中 CVSS 9.6 的路径遍历漏洞允许未经授权的远程代码执行，严重影响开发环境和 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 logic flaw in Discourse MessageBus can leak messages from read-restricted chat channels to unauthorized users, compromising privacy and access controls.
items.reason_zh: Discourse MessageBus 中 CVSS 7.5 的逻辑缺陷可能导致从受限读取的聊天频道向未授权用户泄露消息，破坏隐私和访问控制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.4 authentication bypass in the LatePoint WordPress plugin exposes public booking endpoints to unauthorized access, creating immediate risks for small business websites.
items.reason_zh: LatePoint WordPress 插件中 CVSS 7.4 的身份验证绕过漏洞使公共预订端点暴露于未授权访问之下，对中小企业网站构成直接风险。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access protected API routes and mutate user data by exploiting static asset extension filters.
items.reason_zh: 关键身份验证绕过漏洞允许未认证的远程攻击者通过利用静态资源扩展名过滤器访问受保护的 API 路由并篡改用户数据。

items.reason_en: OS command injection via crafted media file paths enables attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands with Node.js process privileges, compromising web servers.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造的媒体文件路径实现的操作系统命令注入漏洞，使攻击者能够以 Node.js 进程权限执行任意 Shell 命令，从而危及 Web 服务器。

items.reason_en: Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields, leading to session hijacking or administrative account compromise.
items.reason_zh: 存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞允许攻击者将恶意脚本注入表单字段，导致会话劫持或管理员账户被攻破。

items.reason_en: HTTP request smuggling vulnerability arises from improper handling of leading whitespace in headers, enabling cache poisoning and backend request manipulation.
items.reason_zh: HTTP 请求走私漏洞源于对请求头前导空格的错误处理，可导致缓存投毒和后端请求操纵。

items.reason_en: Critical template injection vulnerability in Adobe Commerce enables arbitrary code execution, potentially granting attackers full administrative control over e-commerce platforms.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce 中的关键模板注入漏洞可执行任意代码，可能赋予攻击者对电子商务平台的完全管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Zulip’s OIDC backend incorrectly accepts accounts with false email_verified claims, facilitating widespread account takeover attacks via misconfigured identity providers.
items.reason_zh: Zulip 的 OIDC 后端错误地接受了包含虚假 email_verified 声明的账户，助长了通过配置错误的身份提供商进行的广泛账户接管攻击。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated remote code execution without user interaction, severely impacting e-commerce platforms.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce 的身份验证绕过漏洞可在无需用户交互的情况下实现未认证的远程代码执行，严重冲击电子商务平台。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file upload vulnerability in WordPress JTL-Connector plugin enables complete site takeover due to flawed credential validation.
items.reason_zh: WordPress JTL-Connector 插件的任意文件上传漏洞因凭证验证缺陷导致网站被完全接管。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Channel Software WebAlliance SOAP endpoint permits database exfiltration and backend command execution on Microsoft SQL Server.
items.reason_zh: Channel Software WebAlliance SOAP 端点的 SQL 注入漏洞允许数据库窃取并在 Microsoft SQL Server 上执行后端命令。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated consent names in JTL-Shop are stored and rendered without encoding, leading to stored cross-site scripting in administrative interfaces.
items.reason_zh: JTL-Shop 中未经验证的同意名称在未进行编码的情况下被存储和渲染，导致管理界面出现存储型跨站脚本漏洞。

items.reason_en: Server-side template injection in Frappe ERPNext executes arbitrary expressions via unvalidated message fields, compromising server logic.
items.reason_zh: Frappe ERPNext 的服务端模板注入漏洞通过未验证的消息字段执行任意表达式，破坏服务器逻辑。

items.reason_en: Record creation endpoint in Frappe ERPNext disables permission checks, allowing any authenticated user to escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: Frappe ERPNext 的记录创建端点禁用了权限检查，允许任何已认证用户提升权限。

items.reason_en: Webnus Modern Events Calendar Lite suffers from blind SQL injection, allowing attackers to extract database contents or modify records. As a widely installed WordPress plugin, this poses a direct risk to numerous public-facing event websites.
items.reason_zh: Webnus Modern Events Calendar Lite 存在盲注 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者提取数据库内容或修改记录。作为广泛安装的 WordPress 插件，该漏洞对众多面向公众的活动网站构成直接风险。

items.reason_en: The SimpleForm WordPress plugin lacks capability checks on its registration AJAX endpoint, enabling privilege escalation. Attackers can abuse this to gain administrative control over compromised WordPress sites.
items.reason_zh: SimpleForm WordPress 插件在其注册 AJAX 端点缺乏能力检查，导致权限提升。攻击者可滥用此漏洞获取被入侵 WordPress 站点的管理控制权。

items.reason_en: LifterLMS allows local file inclusion via attacker-controlled shortcode attributes, enabling reading of sensitive configuration files. This flaw impacts eLearning platforms built on WordPress and can lead to further server-side exploitation.
items.reason_zh: LifterLMS 允许通过攻击者控制的短代码属性实现本地文件包含，从而读取敏感配置文件。该缺陷影响基于 WordPress 构建的电子学习平台，并可能导致进一步的服务器端利用。

items.reason_en: VillaTheme Email Template Customizer for WooCommerce permits code injection through template parameters. This affects thousands of e-commerce sites and allows attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code within the WordPress context.
items.reason_zh: WooCommerce 的 VillaTheme Email Template Customizer 允许通过模板参数注入代码。该漏洞影响数千个电子商务网站，并使攻击者能够在 WordPress 环境中执行任意 PHP 代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated eval injection in vBulletin's template runtime allows immediate remote code execution via crafted request parameters. This severely compromises widely deployed community forum infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: vBulletin 模板运行时存在未认证的 eval 注入漏洞，可通过构造的请求参数立即实现远程代码执行。该漏洞严重破坏了广泛部署的社区论坛基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication and nonce verification in AGE-GATE WordPress plugin enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Plugin ecosystems remain a frequent attack vector for web application compromise.
items.reason_zh: AGE-GATE WordPress 插件缺失身份验证和 nonce 验证，导致未认证的远程代码执行。插件生态系统仍是 Web 应用被攻陷的常见攻击向量。

items.reason_en: SQL Injection in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges and execute arbitrary commands, threatening core enterprise data storage.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已授权攻击者提升权限并执行任意命令，威胁企业核心数据存储。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, posing a severe risk to database engine stability and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，对数据库引擎稳定性和数据机密性构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: HTTP/2 header leak in Envoy proxy can expose sensitive routing metadata and disrupt cloud-native service mesh traffic management.
items.reason_zh: Envoy 代理中的 HTTP/2 头部泄漏漏洞可能暴露敏感的路由元数据，并破坏云原生服务网格的流量管理。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening database integrity and enabling full server takeover in on-premises deployments.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的整数溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，威胁数据库完整性，并可在本地部署中实现完整的服务器接管。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server leads to remote code execution, exploiting insecure configuration practices to compromise database servers over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中对不受信任数据的反序列化会导致远程代码执行，利用不安全的配置实践通过网络攻陷数据库服务器。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in .NET and Visual Studio tools allows unauthenticated remote code execution, affecting developers and CI/CD pipelines relying on affected IDEs.
items.reason_zh: .NET 和 Visual Studio 工具中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，影响依赖受影响 IDE 的开发人员和 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 enables remote code execution, risking business application integrity and exposing sensitive corporate data to unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及业务应用程序完整性，并使敏感企业数据面临未授权访问风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 insecure deserialization in SQL Server enables unauthenticated network RCE, severely impacting database integrity and backend application security.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中 CVSS 评分为 8.1 的不安全反序列化漏洞可启用未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，严重破坏数据库完整性及后端应用程序安全性。

items.reason_en: Extremely high-severity heap overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, threatening core data infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中极高危的堆溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行，威胁核心数据基础设施。

items.reason_en: Critical injection flaw in SQL Server enables unauthenticated privilege escalation, compromising database integrity and access controls.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的关键注入缺陷可导致未经身份验证的权限提升，破坏数据库完整性与访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability in SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges, risking unauthorized data manipulation and system compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者提升权限，可能导致未授权的数据篡改及系统被攻陷。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, requiring immediate patching to prevent database takeover.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，需立即修补以防止数据库控制权被接管。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, directly threatening critical enterprise data storage and transactional systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁关键的企业数据存储与事务处理系统。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Exchange Server allows remote code execution, disrupting essential email infrastructure and corporate communications.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的双重释放漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏关键电子邮件基础设施与企业通信服务。

items.reason_en: SQL injection flaw in SQL Server permits privilege escalation and structural database manipulation by authenticated application users.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入缺陷允许已认证的应用程序用户进行权限提升和数据库结构篡改。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible code execution in SQL Server directly threatens critical database integrity, confidentiality, and availability.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中可通过网络访问的代码执行漏洞直接威胁关键数据库的完整性、机密性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Infinite loop vulnerability in .NET/.NET Framework causes reliable denial of service for dependent web applications and middleware stacks.
items.reason_zh: .NET/.NET Framework 中的无限循环漏洞会导致依赖该框架的 Web 应用程序及中间件栈发生稳定的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Unhandled email exception crashes the Parse Server process, enabling denial-of-service attacks using only public application keys during verification flows.
items.reason_zh: 未处理的邮件异常导致 Parse Server 进程崩溃，攻击者仅凭公开的应用程序密钥即可在验证流程中实施拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Manipulated RTP proxy parameters cause out-of-bounds reads in OpenSIPS, risking information disclosure and instability in VoIP signaling infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 被篡改的 RTP 代理参数会在 OpenSIPS 中引发越界读取，危及 VoIP 信令基础设施的信息保密性与稳定性。

items.reason_en: Redash DuckDB query runner defaults to external access, granting users unintended filesystem or network capabilities beyond intended database query boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Redash DuckDB 查询运行程序默认允许外部访问，使用户获得超出预期数据库查询边界的非预期文件系统或网络操作能力。

items.reason_en: Parameter injection in Redash Query Results runner allows attackers to manipulate raw query parameters, threatening data integrity and enabling unauthorized data extraction.
items.reason_zh: Redash 查询结果运行程序中的参数注入漏洞允许攻击者操纵原始查询参数，威胁数据完整性并实现未授权的数据提取。

items.reason_en: Dgraph Zero registers unauthenticated administrative HTTP routes, allowing attackers to manipulate cluster topology and execute arbitrary commands via the /removeNode endpoint.
items.reason_zh: Dgraph Zero 注册了未经身份验证的管理员 HTTP 路由，允许攻击者通过 /removeNode 端点操纵集群拓扑并执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: dbt docs serve exposes an unauthenticated POST /api/v1/query endpoint, enabling unauthorized database queries and potential data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: dbt docs serve 暴露了未经身份验证的 POST /api/v1/query 端点，可导致未授权的数据库查询及潜在的数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Socket.IO Engine.IO protocol fails to properly close HTTP responses for invalid binary POST requests, allowing unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server resources via connection leaks.
items.reason_zh: Socket.IO Engine.IO 协议未能正确关闭无效二进制 POST 请求的 HTTP 响应，允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过连接泄漏耗尽服务器资源。

items.reason_en: SSL context caching flaw in Eclipse Vert.x HTTP client can lead to protocol downgrade or interception, affecting high-performance Java middleware handling sensitive transactions.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Vert.x HTTP 客户端中的 SSL 上下文缓存缺陷可能导致协议降级或中间人拦截，影响处理敏感交易的高性能 Java 中间件。

items.reason_en: Embedded unencrypted Ed25519 private host key in SeaweedFS Helm chart exposes clusters to man-in-the-middle attacks, critical for distributed storage deployments.
items.reason_zh: SeaweedFS Helm Chart 中嵌入的未加密 Ed25519 私钥主机密钥会使集群面临中间人攻击风险，对分布式存储部署构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits authorized attackers to execute code remotely, threatening database integrity and availability.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行代码，威胁数据库完整性与可用性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection flaw in Microsoft Configuration Manager allows network-based privilege escalation, compromising IT management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager 中的 SQL 注入缺陷允许基于网络的权限提升，破坏 IT 管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables unauthorized remote code execution, posing a direct risk to database middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行，对数据库中间件部署构成直接风险。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network, threatening database integrity and enabling lateral movement within enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的反序列化缺陷允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，威胁数据库完整性并支持在企业环境内进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication implementation in Active Directory Federation Services allows network-based spoofing attacks, risking unauthorized access to federated applications and user identities.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中弱化的身份验证实现允许基于网络的欺骗攻击，危及联合应用程序和用户身份的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Configuration Manager allows authenticated privilege escalation via manipulated database queries, bypassing intended access controls.
items.reason_zh: Configuration Manager 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许通过篡改数据库查询实现已认证的权限提升，绕过预期的访问控制。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the .NET runtime enables remote code execution, directly impacting backend middleware and application hosting environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET 运行时中的越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接影响后端中间件与应用托管环境。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows network RCE, directly compromising database engine integrity and enabling full data control.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许网络远程代码执行，直接破坏数据库引擎完整性并实现完全的数据控制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables network privilege escalation, risking persistent unauthorized database access and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致网络权限提升，危及持久的未授权数据库访问及横向移动。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Windows OLE DB permits network RCE, affecting critical data access layer components used by enterprise applications.
items.reason_zh: Windows OLE DB 中的类型混淆漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，影响企业应用程序使用的关键数据访问层组件。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core allows network privilege escalation, undermining framework-level access controls and API security.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的身份验证不当可导致网络权限提升，破坏框架级访问控制与 API 安全性。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, directly threatening database server stability and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库服务器的稳定性与数据机密性。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in the .NET framework creates significant denial-of-service vulnerabilities for backend applications and web services.
items.reason_zh: .NET 框架中低效的算法复杂度会导致后端应用程序和 Web 服务出现严重的拒绝服务漏洞。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.0 stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network, threatening core database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中 CVSS 8.0 的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许具备权限的攻击者通过网络提升权限，威胁核心数据库的完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables unauthorized privilege escalation over a network, risking enterprise content management systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中 CVSS 8.8 的访问控制不当漏洞可允许未经授权的网络权限提升，危及企业内容管理系统。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 path traversal in Dynamics Business Central allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network, compromising critical ERP operations.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central 中 CVSS 8.8 的路径遍历漏洞允许具备权限的攻击者通过网络提升权限，导致关键 ERP 操作受损。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication logic allows attackers knowing a valid password to impersonate any other SCRAM-authenticated user, including administrators and superusers.
items.reason_zh: 身份验证逻辑缺陷允许已知有效密码的攻击者冒充任何其他通过 SCRAM 认证的用户，包括管理员和超级用户。

items.reason_en: Authorization policy bypass flaw allows any authenticated user to circumvent role, scope, and UMA permission checks, undermining enterprise identity management.
items.reason_zh: 授权策略绕过漏洞允许任何已认证用户绕过角色、作用域及 UMA 权限检查，破坏企业身份管理。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization configuration could allow remote attackers to bypass security restrictions, exposing sensitive application resources and violating least-privilege principles.
items.reason_zh: 错误的授权配置可能允许远程攻击者绕过安全限制，暴露敏感的应用程序资源并违反最小权限原则。

items.reason_en: Undertow HTTP server fails to validate Host headers properly, impacting WildFly and JBoss EAP deployments and creating risks for HTTP request smuggling or cache poisoning.
items.reason_zh: Undertow HTTP 服务器未能正确验证 Host 首部，影响 WildFly 和 JBoss EAP 部署，并引发 HTTP 请求走私或缓存投毒风险。

items.reason_en: Unparameterized T-SQL statements in JTL SW GMBH middleware allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary database commands, risking full data exfiltration or manipulation.
items.reason_zh: JTL SW GMBH 中间件中的未参数化 T-SQL 语句允许远程攻击者执行任意数据库命令，可能导致完整的数据泄露或篡改。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in Adobe ColdFusion circumvents security features and grants unauthorized write access to application resources.
items.reason_zh: Adobe ColdFusion 中的关键身份验证绕过漏洞会规避安全功能，并授予对应用程序资源的未授权写入权限。

items.reason_en: SAML authentication bypass in IBM WebSphere Liberty when enabled allows unauthorized access to enterprise applications and sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: 启用时，IBM WebSphere Liberty 中的 SAML 身份验证绕过漏洞可允许未经授权访问企业应用程序和敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in IBM WebSphere undermines integrity checks for deployed modules and extensions.
items.reason_zh: IBM WebSphere 中的加密签名验证绕过漏洞破坏了已部署模块和扩展程序的完整性检查。

items.reason_en: XXE vulnerability in Adobe ColdFusion enables attackers to read sensitive files and directories outside the intended application scope.
items.reason_zh: Adobe ColdFusion 中的 XXE 漏洞使攻击者能够读取预期应用范围之外的敏感文件和目录。

items.reason_en: Progress MarkLogic allows query-execution access to invoke XQuery evaluation functions without required privileges, resulting in server-side code execution. This breaks security boundaries in document-oriented database deployments.
items.reason_zh: Progress MarkLogic 允许查询执行访问在无需所需权限的情况下调用 XQuery 评估函数，从而导致服务端代码执行。此漏洞破坏了面向文档的数据库部署中的安全边界。

items.reason_en: MarkLogic fails to isolate user-supplied code executed via REST and XDBC paths from HTTP session state. Attackers can exploit this to perform cross-request attacks and escalate privileges within the database engine.
items.reason_zh: MarkLogic 未能将通过 REST 和 XDBC 路径执行的由用户提供代码与 HTTP 会话状态隔离。攻击者可利用此缺陷执行跨请求攻击并在数据库引擎内提升权限。

items.reason_en: Adobe ColdFusion permits unrestricted upload of dangerous file types, leading to remote code execution without user interaction. This critically impacts Java-based application servers hosting enterprise web workloads.
items.reason_zh: Adobe ColdFusion 允许无限制上传危险文件类型，导致无需用户交互即可发生远程代码执行。这对托管企业 Web 工作负载的基于 Java 的应用程序服务器造成严重影响。

items.reason_en: ColdFusion contains a code injection vulnerability exploitable by remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. Combined with other middleware flaws, this severely compromises backend application logic and data processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: ColdFusion 存在代码注入漏洞，可被远程攻击者利用以执行任意代码。与其他中间件缺陷结合使用时，会严重破坏后端应用程序逻辑与数据处理流水线。

items.reason_en: Improper data sanitization in IBM i HTTP Server Administration web app allows remote authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code or extract sensitive information. Administrative interfaces for enterprise systems require strict input validation.
items.reason_zh: IBM i HTTP Server Administration Web 应用程序中的数据清理不当允许远程已认证攻击者执行任意代码或提取敏感信息。企业系统的管理接口需要严格的输入验证。

items.reason_en: MariaDB service unit misuse combined with FILE privilege allows database users to manipulate secure-file-priv configurations. Misconfigured database permissions can lead to unauthorized file system access.
items.reason_zh: MariaDB 服务单元滥用结合 FILE 权限可使数据库用户操纵 secure-file-priv 配置。配置不当的数据库权限可能导致未授权的文件系统访问。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in the Windows Update Stack is actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), allowing local privilege escalation via malicious update payloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update Stack 中的链接解析不当漏洞已在野外被积极利用（CISA KEV），允许通过恶意更新载荷实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure CLI allows network-based code execution, compromising developer workflows and infrastructure automation pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Azure CLI 中的命令注入漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，破坏开发者工作流与基础设施自动化流水线。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Visual Studio enables remote code execution during development builds, targeting software engineering environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在开发构建期间导致远程代码执行，针对软件工程环境。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in OpenSSH for Windows allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, significantly weakening secure shell access for Windows system administrators.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 OpenSSH 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经认证的远程代码执行，显著削弱了 Windows 系统管理员的安全 Shell 访问能力。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 kernel heap overflow permits unauthenticated network RCE, representing a critical breakdown of OS-level memory isolation and system stability.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 内核堆溢出漏洞允许未经认证的远程网络代码执行，代表操作系统级内存隔离与系统稳定性的严重崩溃。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 improper input handling in AD CS enables authenticated local privilege escalation, undermining certificate authority trust chains and PKI operations.
items.reason_zh: AD CS 中 CVSS 7.8 的输入处理不当漏洞允许已认证本地权限提升，破坏证书颁发机构信任链与 PKI 操作。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 memory leak in AD DS allows unauthenticated network denial of service, disrupting directory services availability and authentication workflows.
items.reason_zh: AD DS 中 CVSS 7.5 的内存泄漏漏洞允许未经认证的远程拒绝服务，中断目录服务可用性与身份验证工作流。

items.reason_en: Stack overflow in the Node.js braces package causes denial of service when processing deeply nested character patterns in developer toolchains.
items.reason_zh: Node.js braces 软件包中的栈溢出漏洞在处理开发者工具链中的深层嵌套字符模式时会引发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the .NET runtime triggers network-based denial of service during complex syntax parsing and compilation tasks.
items.reason_zh: .NET 运行时中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出在复杂语法解析与编译任务期间会触发基于网络的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited buffer overflow in the GNU C Library dynamic loader allows local privilege escalation via maliciously crafted GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variables.
items.reason_zh: GNU C 库动态加载器中正在被利用的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过恶意构造的 GLIBC_TUNABLES 环境变量实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Unsafe option guard bypass in GitPython enables remote code execution by injecting shell commands through positional refspec arguments.
items.reason_zh: GitPython 中存在不安全的选项守卫绕过机制，可通过位置 refspec 参数注入 Shell 命令，从而导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Manipulated data offsets in safetensors tensor loaders cause buffer overflows, potentially compromising AI inference environments and model serving pipelines.
items.reason_zh: safetensors 张量加载器中被篡改的数据偏移量会导致缓冲区溢出，可能危及 AI 推理环境与模型服务流水线。

items.reason_en: Critical remote command injection in AhsayCBS backup software is actively exploited, allowing complete system takeover, data exfiltration, and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: AhsayCBS 备份软件中存在正在被利用的关键远程命令注入漏洞，可导致系统完全接管、数据外泄及横向移动。

items.reason_en: TLS stack buffer overflow in the Mongoose embedded web server library impacts numerous IoT gateways and lightweight network appliances relying on this open-source component.
items.reason_zh: Mongoose 嵌入式 Web 服务器库中的 TLS 栈缓冲区溢出漏洞影响众多依赖该开源组件的 IoT 网关与轻量级网络设备。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel Bluetooth subsystem contains use-after-free vulnerabilities exploitable remotely via L2CAP connections, potentially allowing kernel code execution and memory leakage.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核蓝牙子系统存在可通过 L2CAP 连接远程利用的释放后使用漏洞，可能导致内核代码执行与内存泄露。

items.reason_en: VS Code Markdown Preview Enhanced extension passes attacker-controlled links to a Windows file-opening helper using child_process.exec, enabling remote code execution on affected developer machines.
items.reason_zh: VS Code Markdown Preview Enhanced 扩展程序使用 child_process.exec 将攻击者控制的链接传递给 Windows 文件打开辅助工具，从而在受影响的开发机上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Symlink and hard-link validation bypass in Ludwig AI framework allows arbitrary file extraction from archives, posing supply chain risks for machine learning pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Ludwig AI 框架中存在符号链接与硬链接验证绕过漏洞，允许从归档文件中提取任意文件，对机器学习流水线构成供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated MCP tool execution in Flyto2 Core bypasses required authentication checks, enabling abuse of AI-agent orchestration workflows and backend integrations.
items.reason_zh: Flyto2 Core 中未经验证的 MCP 工具执行绕过了必需的认证检查，导致 AI 智能体编排工作流与后端集成被滥用。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in .NET allows attackers to bypass security features across cross-platform runtime environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中不当的加密签名验证机制允许攻击者跨平台运行时环境绕过安全功能。

items.reason_en: An integer underflow in the Microsoft Bluetooth Driver enables privilege escalation over adjacent networks, affecting peripheral connectivity security.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft 蓝牙驱动程序中的整数下溢漏洞允许通过相邻网络进行权限提升，影响外设连接安全性。

items.reason_en: Reliance on untrusted inputs in PowerShell security decisions enables remote code execution, affecting system administration and automation workflows.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 安全决策依赖不可信输入可导致远程代码执行，影响系统管理与自动化工作流。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Microsoft PostScript Printer Driver allows unrestricted remote code execution, impacting printing subsystems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft PostScript 打印机驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许无限制的远程代码执行，影响打印子系统。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows Deployment Services permits unauthorized network code execution, jeopardizing enterprise deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Windows Deployment Services 中的竞争条件漏洞允许未经授权的远程代码执行，危及企业部署流水线。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in OpenSSH for Windows allows remote code execution over the network. Directly impacts secure remote administration pipelines and credential management workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 OpenSSH 中的相对路径遍历漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。直接影响安全远程管理流水线及凭据管理工作流。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager enables local code execution. MSMQ is commonly deployed in enterprise messaging architectures, requiring timely remediation.
items.reason_zh: Windows Message Queuing 队列管理器中存在释放后使用漏洞，可启用本地代码执行。MSMQ 常见于企业消息传递架构中，需及时修复。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the Koha Task Scheduler allows remote code execution via unvalidated job parameters. Highlights critical security gaps in open-source library management platforms handling automated tasks.
items.reason_zh: Koha 任务调度器中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，可通过未验证的作业参数实现远程代码执行。凸显了处理自动化任务的开源图书馆管理平台中的关键安全缺陷。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Subsystem for Linux poses local privilege escalation risks for cross-platform developers and containerized workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Subsystem for Linux 中的释放后使用漏洞为跨平台开发者及容器化工作流带来本地权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Installer allows local privilege escalation during system package deployment, potentially compromising update mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows Installer 中的释放后使用漏洞可在系统包部署期间导致本地权限提升，可能破坏更新机制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 resource budget bypass in SGLang allows attackers to override AI model processing limits, leading to compute abuse, financial loss, and service degradation.
items.reason_zh: SGLang 中 CVSS 评分为 7.5 的资源预算绕过漏洞允许攻击者覆盖 AI 模型处理限制，导致计算资源滥用、经济损失及服务降级。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.3 shell injection via malicious modulefiles in Red Hat environment-modules enables local privilege escalation through automated Bash completion triggers.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat environment-modules 中通过恶意 modulefiles 注入 Shell 的命令（CVSS 7.3）可通过自动触发的 Bash 补全机制实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 improper privilege management in Python affects the core runtime, creating cross-platform risks for script execution and system-level operations across diverse environments.
items.reason_zh: Python 中 CVSS 评分为 7.8 的不当权限管理机制影响核心运行时，在不同环境中为脚本执行和系统级操作带来跨平台风险。

items.reason_en: A race condition in Active Directory Certificate Services complicates secure certificate issuance workflows, potentially allowing local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 中的竞争条件漏洞使安全证书颁发工作流复杂化，可能导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication checks in Windows Modern Device Management permit local privilege escalation, bypassing intended device policy enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Windows Modern Device Management 中缺失的认证检查允许本地权限提升，绕过了预期的设备策略执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.7 cryptographic protocol flaw in Eclipse NetX Secure DTLS bypasses cookie verification, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse NetX Secure DTLS 中 CVSS 评分为 8.7 的加密协议缺陷绕过了 Cookie 验证，支持中间人攻击与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.7 unsafe X.509 signature parsing in Eclipse NX crypto library fails to validate empty signatures, potentially allowing certificate validation bypasses.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse NX 加密库中 CVSS 评分为 8.7 的不安全 X.509 签名解析未能验证空签名，可能导致证书验证被绕过。

items.reason_en: TLS 1.3 client processes HelloRetryRequest cookies without proper length validation, risking heap corruption or denial of service during certificate authentication.
items.reason_zh: TLS 1.3 客户端在处理 HelloRetryRequest Cookie 时缺乏适当的长度验证，可能在证书认证期间引发堆损坏或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Certificate chain validation flaw allows non-CA certificates to be accepted as intermediate issuers, enabling certificate forgery and man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: 证书链验证缺陷允许将非 CA 证书接受为中间颁发机构，从而实现证书伪造和中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Roo Code’s command approval mechanism can be bypassed using quote-masking regex techniques, representing a significant security risk for AI-assisted development workflows and automated scripting.
items.reason_zh: Roo Code 的命令审批机制可通过引号掩码正则表达式技术绕过，对 AI 辅助开发工作流和自动化脚本构成重大安全风险。

items.reason_en: Base64 token miscalculation in NSD allows 64KB stack overwrites via crafted zone files, threatening DNS resolver stability and security.
items.reason_zh: NSD 中的 Base64 令牌计算错误允许通过构造的区域文件进行 64KB 栈覆盖，威胁 DNS 解析器的稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: RDATA limit bypass in NSD SVCB/HTTPS records enables unlimited stack writes, risking critical memory corruption in DNS infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: NSD SVCB/HTTPS 记录中的 RDATA 限制绕过漏洞可实现无限制的栈写入，导致 DNS 基础设施面临关键内存损坏风险。

items.reason_en: Text token validation flaw in NSD permits arbitrary-sized out-of-bounds stack writes, potentially overwriting callback function pointers.
items.reason_zh: NSD 中的文本令牌验证缺陷允许执行任意大小的越界栈写入，可能导致回调函数指针被覆盖。

items.reason_en: Unsafe HDF5 graph loading in TensorLayer triggers deserialization attacks when processing untrusted model configurations, risking remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: TensorLayer 中不安全的 HDF5 图加载机制在处理不可信模型配置时可能触发反序列化攻击，进而引发远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Case-sensitivity mismatch in Wazuh config validator bypasses remote-command restrictions, allowing attackers to execute commands as root.
items.reason_zh: Wazuh 配置验证器中的大小写敏感性不匹配漏洞可绕过远程命令限制，使攻击者能够以 root 权限执行命令。

items.reason_en: The Metasploit Framework REST API exposes the credential store without proper authentication on mutating routes. This undermines security testing frameworks and could leak sensitive credentials if exposed to networks.
items.reason_zh: Metasploit Framework 的 REST API 在未对变更类路由进行适当身份验证的情况下暴露了凭据存储库。此举削弱了安全测试框架的安全性，若暴露于网络环境中可能导致敏感凭据泄露。

items.reason_en: JTL WMS MobileServer's authorization middleware fails to enforce authentication on non-GET/HEAD HTTP methods. This allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass security controls and interact with warehouse management APIs.
items.reason_zh: JTL WMS MobileServer 的授权中间件未对非 GET/HEAD 的 HTTP 方法强制实施身份验证。攻击者可借此绕过安全控制，直接与仓储管理 API 进行交互。

items.reason_en: A security regression in Python's URL parsing allows attackers to exploit CVE-2019-9636 by abusing userinfo fields in URLs. This impacts countless Python-based web applications and proxies that parse external URLs.
items.reason_zh: Python URL 解析功能出现安全回退，攻击者可滥用 URL 中的 userinfo 字段来利用 CVE-2019-9636。该漏洞影响大量解析外部 URL 的 Python 生态 Web 应用及代理服务。

items.reason_en: GNU glibc's ARMv7 memcpy implementation contains a signed comparison vulnerability triggered by negative length parameters. This can cause buffer overflows in ARM-based systems, affecting embedded devices and server architectures.
items.reason_zh: GNU glibc 的 ARMv7 memcpy 实现中存在有符号比较漏洞，可由负长度参数触发。该漏洞可能导致基于 ARM 的系统发生缓冲区溢出，波及嵌入式设备与服务器架构。

items.reason_en: Nix package manager repair operations can destroy and replace store paths before content verification, enabling privilege escalation. Supply chain integrity is compromised when build artifacts lack cryptographic guarantees.
items.reason_zh: Nix 包管理器的修复操作可能在完成内容验证前破坏并替换存储路径，从而导致提权。若构建产物缺乏密码学保障，供应链完整性将遭到破坏。

items.reason_en: TinaCMS CLI interpolates raw Git branch values into JavaScript strings, causing code injection during development workflows. Automated CI/CD pipelines processing untrusted branches face execution risks.
items.reason_zh: TinaCMS CLI 会将原始 Git 分支名称直接插值至 JavaScript 字符串中，在开发流程中引发代码注入漏洞。处理不可信分支的自动化 CI/CD 流水线将面临恶意代码执行风险。
